title: Snapshot file is absent after the test runs out of heap
root_cause: The test retains blocks in a JVM capped at 32 MiB and exhausts its heap before writing the snapshot. The subsequent cat failure is a consequence of the missing output from that interrupted test.

relevant_evidence.why: The heap error precedes the failed attempt to display the output file.
The Gradle test JVM has a 32 MiB heap limit.
The test retains blocks before writing the output.
